# AsoFast

> AsoFast is an open source ASO (App Store Optimization) tool for mobile developers. It generates App Store and Google Play listings: titles, subtitles, descriptions, keywords, multilingual translations, and marketing screenshots. Self-hosted, MIT licensed, 100% free.

## Vitrine / Landing

- [Home](https://asofast.app/): Open source ASO tool for App Store & Google Play. Features, how it works, screenshots of the dashboard, FAQ, and calls to action pointing to the GitHub repository.
- [Blog](https://asofast.app/blog/): Practical guides on ASO, app store keyword research, Google Play descriptions, App Store screenshots, localization, and getting started with App Store Optimization.

## Produit

- [Source code (GitHub)](https://github.com/ediaStudio/asofast): The AsoFast application itself, self-hosted, MIT license.
- [Landing repo (GitHub)](https://github.com/ediaStudio/asofastLanding): Source of this static site.
